data: Which training methods are represented in the figure?

The figure shows two learning curves for two different training methods: RL training and SL training. The curves are averaged over four independent training runs on the DE→EN direction. The x-axis represents training steps multiplied by 50. The y-axis is labeled AL ↓ for the top graph and BLEU ↑ for the bottom graph. The red line represents RL training, and the blue line represents SL training. A black dot indicates the reported RL model (CW=5 Fig.2).
